sentences.text: Stanley `` Tookie '' Williams III -LRB- December 29 , 1953 -- December 13 , 2005 -RRB- was an American gang member and convicted murderer , who was part of the West Side Crips , a street gang which has its roots in South Central Los Angeles in 1969 .
